content.value_statement: Video creators need reliable prompts and settings for HappyHorse 1.0 without guessing the API schema. This skill prepares RunComfy CLI calls and practical prompt guidance for text-to-video generation.
actual_capabilities: Routes explicit HappyHorse text-to-video requests to the RunComfy model workflow.
Defines valid inputs for prompt, aspect ratio, resolution, duration, seed, and watermark.
Provides prompt guidance for motion, camera direction, shot sequencing, and audio cues.
Suggests related video models when users need lip-sync, motion control, or faster iteration.
Explains CLI behavior, exit codes, output downloads, endpoints, and token handling.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, a RunComfy account, and network access.
Covers text-to-video only; image-to-video uses a separate pipeline.
Supports clips from 3 to 15 seconds and five documented aspect ratios.
Depends on RunComfy service availability, billing rules, and model limits.

use_cases.title: Produce short brand videos
use_cases.description: Create concise 1080p clips with consistent characters, clear motion, and synchronized ambience.

use_cases.title: Prototype cinematic scenes
use_cases.description: Test camera language, character anchors, scene beats, and audio direction before a larger production.

use_cases.title: Automate video generation requests
use_cases.description: Prepare valid RunComfy CLI inputs and understand expected endpoint, polling, and download behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a basic clip
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple HappyHorse video.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use HappyHorse 1.0 to create a five second 16:9 video. The scene is a cyclist crossing a quiet bridge at sunrise.

prompt_templates.title: Create a vertical social ad
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with platform format and product focus.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 9:16 HappyHorse 1.0 clip for a coffee brand. Show steam, hand motion, warm cafe sound, and no dialogue.

prompt_templates.title: Build a multi-shot character scene
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that needs character consistency.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use HappyHorse 1.0 for two shots with the same detective in a gray coat. Keep wardrobe, lighting, and voice consistent.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a model routing decision
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request comparing HappyHorse with related models.
prompt_templates.prompt: I need a short video with native audio, stable character identity, and 1080p output. Decide if HappyHorse 1.0 is the right model.

output_examples.input: A vertical cafe product shot with steam, morning light, and soft ambient sound.
output_examples.output: The skill selects a vertical format, suggests an eight second duration, and frames the prompt around motion, texture, and sound.

output_examples.input: A two-shot story where the same astronaut crosses a lunar plain and looks back at Earth.
output_examples.output: The skill repeats the astronaut identity across both shots and recommends consistent costume, camera distance, lighting, and audio cues.

output_examples.input: A user asks for lip-sync driven by an existing audio file.
output_examples.output: The skill explains that this template is text-to-video only and recommends a model that supports audio-driven lip-sync.

best_practices: Describe motion over time instead of only describing a still image.
Restate character anchors in each shot when requesting multi-shot consistency.
Use a short 720p test pass before requesting a final 1080p render.
anti_patterns: Do not combine many unrelated actions in one short clip.
Do not use unsupported aspect ratios or durations above 15 seconds.
Do not submit sensitive prompt content without reviewing third-party transfer risk.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It helps generate HappyHorse 1.0 text-to-video clips through RunComfy.

faq.question: Does it require a RunComfy account?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow requires the RunComfy CLI and authentication with a RunComfy account or token.

faq.question: Can it create image-to-video output?
faq.answer: No. This template covers the text-to-video endpoint only.

faq.question: What clip lengths are supported?
faq.answer: The documented duration range is 3 to 15 seconds.

faq.question: Does prompt content stay local?
faq.answer: No. The workflow sends prompt requests to the RunComfy Model API.

faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
